hypothesis: With a frozen one-step FP32 WM, matching the teacher's physical next-state features can weight action imitation by learned local dynamics without supplying future inputs to the student
claim_scope: Independent model-mediated distillation hypothesis, not a faithful GigaBrain loss reproduction and not evidence that physical gradients cause the observed f0 falls
wm_precision: Independent same-weight FP32 shadow only; original native bf16 configuration and all files unchanged; TF32 disabled
data: Reuse all owned original R1 and AGGREGATE01 train/validation records, including original actual state, paired teacher action and source/frame identities; no new collection or test data
control: Strictly reuse the completed PAIR02 action-only arm and its original initialization, source-balanced indices, settings, per-validation batch hashes and source exposure counts; require exact audit before dispatch
single_changed_training_variable: Add fixed coefficient 0.1 times physical feature distillation loss to the original present-joint action MSE; no auxiliary learned head
physical_target: Stop-gradient one-step FP32 WM prediction at the same saved actual state/context under its saved teacher action; never the next state under a different logged mixture action
physical_candidate: One-step FP32 WM prediction at the identical saved state/context under the student's canonical29 action; no extra actuator-scale factor
physical_loss: Mean squared difference of canonical physical features in one detached current-state frame, divided by frozen normalizer std and masked by feature_presence; exclude the deterministic command-memory tail
information_limit: This changes the optimization geometry of existing teacher-action supervision. It adds no missing future information and cannot by itself establish that f0 is observable or that closed-loop balance improves
selection: Keep original validation action risk, equal state origins then equal source clips, including update0 and original validation points; no test-based selection and no changed score chosen after results
required_exact_settings: Any field here inconsistent with the source-audited original action-only control must block dispatch; publish a revised plan before any runtime change
finite_checks: Finite student action, masked physical prediction and loss each batch, finite encoder gradients, frozen component tensor SHA before/after, exact absent-joint zero contribution
checkpoint_delivery: Finite CPU selected/last saves and actual Adam counters, validation and auxiliary metrics, source/batch/exposure receipts, training six-panel PNG/PDF/CSV
closed_loop_gate: Only a genuinely changed selected encoder may enter an independent bounded review with nominal and stop/reverse/dropout/late-burst matched controls; if update0 is identical, reuse existing0/7 evidence and do not repeat it
cache_boundary: Reuse original R2 boundary; no new advice/drop or deletion
required_before_dispatch: Published source manifest and resource/cost plan
